description: This file defines the AnnouncementRepository class responsible for managing database operations related to Announcement entities, such as retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion. It includes methods for fetching announcements by ID, counting total announcements, listing active and inactive announcements, and persisting changes.

classes.name: AnnouncementRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling database interactions related to Announcement objects in the Goteo platform.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an Announcement by its ID from the database.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of announcements.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of announcements with pagination.

methods.name: getActiveList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active announcements with pagination.

methods.name: getActiveWithoutDonationList
methods.description: Retrieves active announcements excluding those of donation type.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Creates or updates an Announcement in the database.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Inserts a new Announcement record into the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Announcement record in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an Announcement record from the database.
